verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official CLI for developing Slack apps (docs.slack.dev/tools/slack-cli), with commands like `slack create` for scaffolding Bolt projects, confirmed by both docs and a live probe. This CLI is aimed at building agentic/AI apps on the platform, aligning with the ai-native/agenticness theme, though it's a developer/app-building tool rather than an end-user AI chat CLI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the CLI's AI-native workflows and more detail on CLI feature depth beyond scaffolding commands.
